description: Write-Audit-Publish (WAP) lifecycle for assets. Wraps a compute function; writes output to a STAGING location; runs audit checks; on ALL pass promotes staging → prod, on any fail applies quarantine/discard/tag_and_keep policy. Each audit check emits an AssetCheckResult visible in Dagster's asset-check panel — downstream can block via AutomationCondition. Three backends in v1: filesystem (parquet/csv/json, local + fsspec URIs), SQL (via sqlalchemy, transactional table swap), Iceberg (via pyiceberg, branch fast_forward). Companion `@lifecycle` decorator wraps existing @dg.asset functions.

outputs.description: One @dg.asset whose materialization is compute → staging → audit → publish. Includes AssetCheckResult per audit. Metadata: wap_write_kind, wap_all_passed, wap_publish_outcome, wap_check_summary.

write.label: Write
write.description: Write backend. filesystem: {kind, prod_path, staging_path?, format?}. sql: {kind, resource_key|database_url_env_var, prod_table, staging_table?, schema?}. iceberg: {kind, catalog, table, staging_branch?}.

audit.label: Audit Checks
audit.description: Ordered checks. Kinds: row_count_min, row_count_max, col_null_ratio_max, col_unique, col_range_min, col_range_max, python.

quarantine.label: Quarantine
quarantine.description: Target for on_fail=quarantine. filesystem: {quarantine_path}. sql: {quarantine_table}. iceberg: {quarantine_tag}.

raise_on_fail.label: Raise on Fail
raise_on_fail.description: Raise dg.Failure on audit fail. Set false to materialize + rely on downstream AutomationCondition on AssetCheckResult.

name: Lifecycle WAP
